music.prompt: A 26-second sunny, upbeat indie-pop commercial track at 112 BPM: bright strummed acoustic guitar, ukulele, handclaps, a punchy kick and a bouncy bass. For the first eight seconds it is light and bouncy, just guitar, ukulele and claps under a voiceover. At eight and a half seconds the full band kicks in with the kick and bass, cheerful and driving, and it stays bright and full, then ends on one big final strum at twenty-five seconds that rings out to silence. Instrumental, crisp and uncluttered production with room for a voiceover.

lines.text: [excited] Rise and shine! [playfully] Your juice has been up since five-forty.
Real fruit. Cold-pressed. [chuckles] That's the whole recipe.
It's waiting on your corner... [playfully] before you've even found your shoes.
[confident] Never from concentrate. Never from yesterday.

sfx.prompt: Soft early-morning orchard ambience with distant birdsong.
A short soft whoosh into a camera-flash pop.
A full juice carton set down on a wooden table, a soft dull thud.
A kraft paper shopping bag rustling as it swings.
A quiet early-morning city street, a bus pulling away in the distance.
An electric delivery van rolling past slowly, soft tyre noise on asphalt.
Light open-air wind high above a road.
Juice poured into a glass over ice, ending on one clean bright ding.
